description: Angular component for a phone input field with country code selection, validation, and formatting.

classes.name: PhoneInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a customizable phone number input with country code and validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls, subscriptions, and loads phone number parsing library.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the phone number input, initializing with country calling code if empty.

methods.name: getFlagAndPhoneNumberData
methods.description: Sets flag icon and fetches example phone number data for a given country.

methods.name: getPhoneNumberData
methods.description: Retrieves example phone number and country calling code for a country.

methods.name: getFlagIcon
methods.description: Generates flag icon based on country code.

methods.name: updateModelValueInFormat
methods.description: Formats parsed phone number to E.164 and updates model value.

methods.name: validatePhoneNumber
methods.description: Returns a validator function to check phone number validity.

methods.name: defineCountryFromNumber
methods.description: Sets country in form based on parsed phone number.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form group.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a phone number value into the form, parsing and setting country accordingly.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change based on form value.
